title: Understanding Exponential Regularization
text: Exponential regularization uses the formula Pow(theta)=lambda*sum{i=1}{p}{10**theta_i}. This means that each parameter $$\theta_i$$ is raised to the power of $$10$$ and then summed up. How does this affect large positive and negative coefficients?

title: Comparing L2 and Exponential Regularization
text: L2 regularization penalizes parameters by squaring them, while exponential regularization raises them to the power of $$10$$. Which method do you think would result in smaller parameter values?

title: Feature Selection with L1 Regularization
text: L1 regularization is known for its ability to perform feature selection by setting some parameters to zero. Does exponential regularization have a similar effect?

title: Analyzing Statement C
text: Consider the statement: 'L2 regularization is more effective than exponential regularization when we want parameters close to zero.' Is this statement true or false?
